mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.name, p.shop_id, p.shop_name, p.audit_status, p.submit_time, p.audit_time, p.main_image, MIN(s.price) as min_price, MAX(s.price) as max_price, SUM(s.stock) as stock_sum FROM product p LEFT JOIN sku s ON p.id = s.product_id WHERE p.audit_status = 'approved' GROUP BY p.id

SELECT p.id, p.name, p.shop_id, p.shop_name, p.audit_status, p.submit_time, p.audit_time, p.main_image, MIN(s.price) as min_price, MAX(s.price) as max_price, SUM(s.stock) as stock_sum FROM product p LEFT JOIN sku s ON p.id = s.product_id WHERE p.status = '0' GROUP BY p.id

select p.id, p.name,p.main_image as mainImage, p.shop_name as shopName, p.audit_status as auditStatus, p.audit_reason as auditReason, p.submit_time as submitTime, p.audit_time as auditTime, MIN(s.price) as minPrice, MAX(s.price) as maxPrice, SUM(s.stock) as stockSum from product p left join sku s on p.id=s.product_id where p.status=#{status} GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.main_image, p.shop_id, p.shop_name, p.audit_status, p.audit_reason, p.submit_time, p.audit_time ORDER BY p.submit_time DESC
mapper.update: update product set reject_reason=#{reason} where id=#{id};
mapper.delete: delete p,s from product p left join sku s on p.id=s.product_id where p.id=#{id}
delete p,s from product p left join sku s on p.id=s.product_id where p.id in (${ids})
